create_mcp_server: create a new external MCP server in the database with authentication and access group configuration
fetch_mcp_servers: fetch all configured MCP servers filtered by the requesting user's access permissions
fetch_mcp_tools: list all available MCP tools for the current API key including access group tools
register_mcp_server: submit a new MCP server for admin review with pending approval status
discover_mcp_servers: discover curated well-known MCP servers with search and category filtering
